title: App code never registers HTTP surface on the composed app object
intent: ``terp.core.create_app`` mounts every module router behind the deny-by-default policy guard. Surface registered on the composed app itself — ``app.mount(...)``, ``app.include_router(...)``, ``app.add_route(...)``, a verb decorator on a ``create_app``-produced app, or a lifecycle hook (``app.on_event`` / ``app.add_event_handler``) — is served or executed WITHOUT that guard and is invisible to the module permission model. Modules declare one flat router on their ``ModuleSpec``; composition mounts it.
